Are you an anime newbie? A seasoned veteran? Have you never heard of Fate/Zero? Have you watched it ten times? Regardless, all are welcome to join in /v/Anime's first communal viewing of Fate/Zero.

If your impression of anime is that it's the forte of children, and that there's nothing here for you, then please allow Fate/Zero to change your mind. A darker show, F/Z is vastly different from more mainstream titles, such as Pokemon, Dragon Ball Z, or even Sword Art Online. It contains an intricate story, very well-developed characters who play off of each other splendidly, and a budget that could probably buy a small country (which directy results in absolutely beautiful animation). This show is a tad more on the mature side, as it deals with some very utilitarian themes and there are some gore-y scenes. But if you just want a show with awesome action and a cool story, this will definitely appeal to you, too.

That's quite a debateable point. It is an almost constant refrain amongst people who claim to have had 'mystical' experiences. Insofar as this is not simply a 'dodge' I would presume that it 'means' that words cannot capture the full description of the subjective experience. That may be true to some degree. Recently a meme has been travelling around the internet involving a dress that some people see as one color while others see a totally different color. The actual 'color' can be described objectively by the wavelength of light that it reflects, but the subjective experience isn't captured by such a description. Other examples could be drawn by comparing languages. Some languages are much more precise in describing things like number, color, scent, relationships, etc.. The particular item would be 'ineffable' in the deficient language, but quite obvious in the more 'rich' one.
